name: ms-argus-pair
description: Argus phone-pair captcha demo — dual-scan co-attestation between desktop and phone

scripts.test:hygiene: node scripts/assert-build-hygiene.mjs && npm run test:argus-loader-sri && npm run test:proof-menu && npm run test:phone-scan-lazy && npm run test:phone-entry-build && npm run test:sso-continuity && npm run test:sso-routes && npm run test:sso-demo-ux && npm run test:qr-connected && npm run test:ws-single && npm run test:spa-router
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run dead-code && npm run duplication && npm test
scripts.deploy: source .env 2>/dev/null; PAIR_HOST=$(node cdk/bin/print-pair-host.mjs) && WS_URL=$(node cdk/bin/print-ws-url.mjs) && VITE_PAIR_URL_BASE="https://${PAIR_HOST}" VITE_PAIR_WS_URL="${WS_URL}" npm run build && EMBED_ORIGIN="https://${PAIR_HOST}" npm run build:loader && npm run test:hygiene && node cdk/bin/assert-baked-host.mjs "${PAIR_HOST}" && npx cdk deploy --all -c merchantApiUrl="${MERCHANT_API_URL:-}" -c merchantApiCredential="${MERCHANT_API_CREDENTIAL:-}" -c merchantCpi="${MERCHANT_CPI:-}" -c oauthGoogleClientId="${OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:-}" -c oauthGithubClientId="${OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID:-}" -c oauthGithubClientSecretArn="${OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET_ARN:-}" -c oauthFacebookAppId="${OAUTH_FACEBOOK_APP_ID:-}" -c oauthFacebookAppSecretArn="${OAUTH_FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET_ARN:-}" --require-approval never
